Author: naco-ff14
Name: AltMate
Description: AltMate supports multiple FFXIV clients running on the same PC. It provides automatic follow and multi-seat mount assistance, combat and travel synchronization, housing lottery/open-plot tracking, Penumbra emote playback, and shared gil summaries. Control messages stay on the local PC. Optional web sync uploads selected observations to your private Supabase dashboard, with device pairing and encrypted local storage. Web sync is off by default. The interface supports Japanese and English.
Punchline: Multi-character linking, housing, animation, and gil tools
Changelog: v1.62.20: Adds multi-item company craft plans inspired by the submarine-parts material sheet. Combine multiple projects and quantities, total supply requirements, compare all-character storage, expand shortages recursively to raw materials, and inspect intermediate breakdowns.
